other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the reported Panchayats of the identified blocks in the specified districts
Applicant must be registered on the DBT portal
Applicant's bank account must be linked with the Aadhaar number
Actual cultivators will be verified jointly by the Agriculture Coordinator and Farmer Advisor
Only genuine cultivators are eligible for the subsidy
benefits_summary: Provides subsidies of up to ₹22,500 per hectare for irrigated/perennial crops and a minimum subsidy of ₹1,000‑₹2,500 per hectare depending on crop type.
